resources.string: Lets RemoteScroll perform swipes and taps on the screen when you press buttons on your Bluetooth media remote, so you can scroll TikTok without touching the screen. RemoteScroll only reacts to the Next, Previous and Play/Pause keys and does not read screen content.

1. Enable the accessibility service.
2. Start the remote service.
3. Open TikTok and use your Bluetooth remote:

• Next: next video (swipe up)
• Previous: previous video (swipe down)
• Hold Next: volume up
• Hold Previous: volume down
• Play/Pause: tap centre (pause/resume)
Shown while RemoteScroll is listening for media buttons
Enable the RemoteScroll accessibility service first
